result.description: Compact desktop ambient speaker for home offices and study spaces. Designed for soft background audio, timer-based soundscapes, and Bluetooth playback. Includes a woven grille, touch controls, USB-C power input, and a small internal battery for short wireless use. Tuned for midrange clarity rather than deep bass, with a focus on relaxation and productivity environments.
result.title: Lunora QuartzDesk Ambient Speaker
